'''mas more dangerous then u realize''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mas]]
* '''Published:''' 26 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif|label=Dantooine Base Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dantooine Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 DBO mas LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

dantoine old-school deck

The published list has 61 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 61 as published (no section headers). The line 'Planet Defend Ion Gun / Orbital Mine' is dested as two cards, Planet Defender Ion Cannon and Orbital Mine; if it was meant as one slot (either/or), the deck is 60.
* Posted 'Ion Canon' x2 dested SW-4 Ion Cannon (the only Light 'Ion Cannon'); 'Rocher' Roche; 'Raltir' Ralltiir; 'Koenseyr Manufactory' Koensayr Manufacturing; 'Weapon Display' the printed Weapons Display Effect; 'B-Wing Assualt Sq.' B-wing Attack Squadron.
* Spaceport Docking Bay, Spaceport City, Spaceport Street and Swamp are the generic Special Edition sites.

== Strategy ==

the plan is to play swamp on dantoine to play nudjs and rebel guards there. it would be hard to deploy or flip the objectiv for imperials.

Then u might want to drain at raltir, using raltir captains, operatives and rebel sq. leader (for spaceport city)

the rest is all about kessel running, weapon destining and squadron fighting.

if it's possible u should retrive kessel run, when finishing the other one for endless retrivin
